responsibility: This C header exposes the small foreign-function interface from C lexer code into the Modula-2 mcComment module. It publishes the entry points needed by the scanner to create a new comment descriptor and append comment text, allowing lexing code generated or written in C to populate mc’s higher-level comment objects during tokenization.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the C-facing bridge in the mcComment stem: it exposes only the foreign-function entry points mcComment_initComment and mcComment_addText for scanner code, unlike the .def file’s full Modula-2 API and the .mod file’s internal comment classification and retrieval implementation.
